License

The license activation page allows you to enter your product key to activate Manager Server edition.

A valid product key is required to use Manager Server edition beyond the trial period.

Activating Your License

To activate Manager, enter your product key in the field provided. Product keys are formatted as six groups of characters separated by hyphens (XXXXXXX-XXXXXXX-XXXXXXX-XXXXXXX-XXXXXXX-XXXXXXX).

After entering your key, click the Continue button to validate and activate your license.

Obtaining a Product Key

Product keys are provided when you purchase a Manager Server license. You will receive your key via email after completing your purchase.

If you don't have a product key yet, you can purchase a license by visiting the Manager website through the link provided on this page.

License Validation

The system validates that your product key is correctly formatted and matches a valid license. If your key is invalid, you will receive an error message prompting you to try again.

Product keys are tied to specific version ranges. If your key has expired for the current version, you will need to renew your license to continue using the latest version of Manager.
